title: GLM 5.3 Flash Free
notes: Zhipu. The only free model that publishes pdf input, and the only one with structured output and a zero-retention policy at the same time. The pdf does not work: the provider's endpoint rejects a `file` content part, and OpenCode will not read a binary file, so documents are extracted locally first. It is the slowest route on the tier at 16-27s, which is why it sits on the thorough lane rather than a fast one.
